Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.logging

Class ActionChainLogger

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.logging.ActionChainLogger
@Component public class ActionChainLogger extends Object
Specialized logging for action chains with step-by-step tracking. Provides detailed logging for complex action sequences.
